body:
Founder: flashlight 'doesnt seem to be working correctly...expecting it to be a light source...barley circle of light...like 8 pixels.' Root cause confirmed by capturing the cone apex's own clip-space w through the real camera VP: it was exactly 0 (the apex sat AT the eye, a real degenerate near-plane vertex), collapsing the whole triangle fan under GPU clipping. Fixed: apex now starts FLASHLIGHT_APEX_OFFSET (1 unit) in front of the eye, not at it -- same fix every real spotlight effect needs. Live-verified via Xvfb before/after (w=0 confirmed, then a real large visible beam confirmed after the fix). All temp debug code removed. Commit 900283d.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix flashlight beam clip-space singularity (8px dot bug)
